copy.headline: Wind Advisory for Tarrant and 45 other North Texas counties from midnight Saturday Night to noon Sunday
copy.caption:
The National Weather Service has issued a Wind Advisory for Montague, Cooke, Grayson, Fannin, Lamar, Young, Jack, Wise, Denton, Collin, Hunt, Delta, Hopkins, Stephens, Palo Pinto, Parker, Tarrant, Dallas, Rockwall, Kaufman, Van Zandt, Rains, Eastland, Erath, Hood, Somervell, Johnson, Ellis, Henderson, Comanche, Mills, Hamilton, Bosque, Hill, Navarro, Freestone, Anderson, Lampasas, Coryell, Bell, McLennan, Falls, Limestone, Leon, Milam and Robertson counties from midnight Saturday Night to noon Sunday.

A Wind Advisory means that sustained winds of at least 20 to 30 mph are expected.

story.summary: Wind Advisory issued November 27 at 11:36PM CST until November 29 at 12:00PM CST by NWS Fort Worth TX. * WHAT...Northwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph. * WHERE...All of North and Central Texas. * WHEN...From midnight Saturday Night to noon CST Sunday. * IMPACTS...Unsecured outdoor items may be blown around in the wind. Driving on area roadways may become difficult, especially for high-profile vehicles. Small tree limbs could break and cause damage.

extra.instruction: A Wind Advisory means that sustained winds of at least 20 to 30 mph are expected. Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high profile vehicles. Boaters should use extra caution when venturing onto area lakes.
